cause: The first diagnostics contribution did not expose the declared columns, support threshold, bins, statistics, or plan body as an immutable holdout-release contract.
impact: A downstream consumer could not independently explain which subgroup and shift facts were authorized, and a mutable diagnostics plan could change the evidence identity after construction.
lesson: Holdout subgroup and shift evidence must be an exact, immutable, predeclared section with a self-contained plan and descriptive-only statistics.
